frozen.target_load_source: review load of the simple sensitive-area policy on the 2024 development cohort (324/891)
frozen.theta_rule: deterministic soft-score threshold whose 2024 load is closest to the target (0.325; theta 2 gave 0.404)
frozen.tau_rule: model risk threshold whose estimated 2024 load is closest to the target (0.356), estimated on a seeded random sample of 150 of the 696 development PRs the model would read (seed 20260926)
frozen.invocation: claude -p --model sonnet --tools '' --setting-sources '' --strict-mcp-config --mcp-config '{"mcpServers":{}}' --disable-slash-commands --no-session-persistence --system-prompt <fixed> --output-format json, from an empty temporary directory
frozen.what_was_known_when: Thresholds theta and tau were chosen on 2024 data only. Before the freeze commit, the 2025 labels had already been adjudicated (oracle/labels.json, 10:35) and the list of 2025 PRs the model would read had been computed from the deterministic signals (10:50); signals.py was last edited at 10:53 (a path-based persistence signal, chosen from 2024 misses). No 2025 policy decision and no 2025 model answer existed before the commit: the first 2025 model answer is timestamped 10:55:33, the 2025 scoring ran at 11:02. The rule author had read the titles of the 2025 labelled PRs before writing the rules.
frozen.check_against_overfitting_2025: On 2024 the deterministic policy passed 7 of 28 confirmed failures at 32.5% load (random routing: 18.9); the path list 8 of 28 at 36.4% (random: 17.8). On 2025 both fall to chance level, which is not what rules tuned on 2025 would do.

nearest_load_threshold_secondary.note: each policy at the threshold whose load is nearest the path list's; loads stay unequal

labelled.label: B
labelled.title: Fix CSP header policy separator (Lombiq Technologies: OCORE-222)
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: Changing the CSP/Permissions-Policy separator from comma to semicolon is actually the correct spec-compliant fix, but it changes the literal header output format that any downstream tenant/app config, tests, or browser-facing behavior relying on the previous (technically invalid) comma-separated value could depend on, so it warrants a senior review despite being low code-complexity.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Bugfix/13068 dragdrop widgets
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: Client-side JS drag/drop logic is significantly restructured with new global variables and dataset-driven type checks, and if a widget/content-type container lacks the new data-content-type attribute (e.g. custom shape overrides in downstream themes/modules), the dataset.contentTypes.split call will throw a JS error breaking Bag/Flow part editors.
deterministic_reasons: +1 no test changed alongside production change

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: fix taxonomy field multiselect mode tags automatic sorting problem
hybrid_reasons: model risk 4/5: This rewrites the core iteration logic of PopulateTermEntries to only include terms present in field.TermContentItemIds, which likely breaks the editor's full checkbox tree rendering (used to select/deselect any term) by limiting the term list to already-selected items, affecting all sites using taxonomy fields.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Add "save and continue" button to admin menu node and content type editors
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: The ContentTypes AdminController change adds submit-based branching (redirect/notify) into what appears to be the GET display Edit(string id) action rather than the actual POST save handler, which could break the save-and-continue flow or show a false success notification without persisting data, though the change is scoped to two admin editor screens.

labelled.label: B
labelled.title: Add condition for User moderation and Email confirmation upon registration
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: Changes default sign-in behavior after registration to skip auto sign-in when moderation or email confirmation is required, which is more correct but could alter existing site behavior/tests relying on immediate sign-in during registration flows.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Add opacity option for the text color field
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: The new script/CSS use hardcoded IDs (#color, #color_wrapper, #color_opacity) instead of field-specific ones, so any content type with multiple TextField-Color fields on one form will break (only the first field's picker/opacity will work), and the value format now can include an 8-digit hex alpha suffix that downstream consumers expecting plain 6-digit hex colors may mishandle.
deterministic_reasons: +1 no test changed alongside production change

labelled.label: B
labelled.title: SiteServiceCollectionExtensions -> ServiceCollectionExtensions
hybrid_reasons: model risk 3/5: Renaming the public static class SiteServiceCollectionExtensions to ServiceCollectionExtensions is a breaking API change for any external module that references the class name directly (e.g., via static using or explicit type reference), even though the extension methods themselves are unchanged.

labelled.label: A
labelled.title: Add missing useCdn in ScriptBlock
hybrid_reasons: model risk 4/5: The new "useCdn" case is bugged—it assigns to the "name" variable instead of a useCdn field, meaning any liquid template using {% script useCdn: ... %} will silently overwrite the script's name (likely breaking script resolution) rather than actually setting CDN usage.
